'''Dancer''' is a [[performance]] skill. It is used when performing a dance. Dancers may visit your fortress like bards and [[poet]]s and will sometimes petition to stay to entertain. Dwarves watching a performance will sometimes receive a positive thought. Dancers will usually perform in [[taverns]].
